coverage_note: Whole file read in order. Big holes: lines 14:11-25:56 (apologize drills) and 32:34-34:01 have Medi's Arabic as [speaking foreign language]/[speaking Arabic] so his actual forms are invisible; rows there quote her fix and mark the wrong piece from her words (low confidence). 27:46 onward is Latin-transliterated by the engine (kharab, kanit, tadaitni...) so shadda/doubled-middle errors (B12) are often unreadable: bitkharab/khirbat rows are low confidence. Pronunciation-only slips left out: behtr (be7re2), ma tarat (ma6arat), computuri, alefiki (ya3tiki el-3afye), pantalon (ban6aloan), stawarini. 'كم أنا؟' at 39:17/42:10 is likely 'kamaan?' and was skipped. Chat 09:48 'talaate u rube3' has no matching Medi line. English-only meta stretches: 16:00-17:35 (apologize from/to debate), 34:44-36:21 (tense/pointer questions), 1:02:44-1:03:23 (his AI project).
